answer: Anchor each agent identity to one indivisible reputation kernel built only from peer-verified work over many epochs. The kernel cannot be copied, split, or transferred: a second identity starts from zero, and splitting effort across clones leaves every copy below the admission threshold, so a Sybil attacker must redo the full history for each fake. Like copper wiring, it works only as one continuous conductor. Spot checks demand recent work artifacts; failure burns a deposit and freezes the kernel, making mass fakery costly in time, not just tokens.
